findings.what: Set a 5-minute first-reply target in staffed hours.
findings.evidence: Chats answered in under 5 minutes became a sale 18.1% of the time (149 chats); chats answered after more than an hour, 4.8% (186 chats). These are different chats, so this shows a link, not proof.

findings.what: Add an away message that asks the first qualification question.
findings.evidence: 33.6% of matched chats (152) started outside Mon to Sat 09:00 to 19:00 and became a sale 4.6% of the time, against 12.0% inside hours.
findings.who: your team does this in the inbox; if the gap stays, next an on-call coordinator for the busiest unstaffed hours, then an ad schedule set in Ads Manager

findings.what: Give "WA Implants ES video" more budget in steps; it sells at $129 per sale, under 0.7x the target.
findings.evidence: $129 per sale on 19 sales (target $300), even though each conversation costs $27.96, above the account's $19.32 average. Return 30.5x.
findings.who: do this in Ads Manager (budget changes are out of scope)

findings.what: Fix the chat behind "IG Invisalign reel": answer Instagram Direct within 5 minutes and replace the greeting.
findings.evidence: $421 per sale against the $300 target. Where it breaks: the chat: 61% qualify (account 43%), but only 12% of qualified chats become a sale (account 22%). In staffed hours only 13% of Instagram Direct chats were answered within 5 minutes and 60% waited over an hour or got no reply. The greeting asks no question and the only starter is "Tell me more".
findings.who: your team does this (inbox staffing); the new greeting needs a new creative and ad, built paused

findings.what: Pause "Messenger Whitening offer" and move its budget to a WhatsApp version with a new message kit.
findings.evidence: Messenger, $1,618 spent, 149 conversations at $10.86 each (the cheapest chats in the account), but no sale: spend is over 2x the $300 target with nothing to show. Where it breaks: the ad: 11% of its chats qualify against 43% across all matched chats. The creative has no greeting set, so people saw Meta's default and the team had no idea what they wanted. WhatsApp is where the team answers fastest: 69% of WhatsApp chats in staffed hours were answered within 5 minutes, against 44% on Messenger.
findings.who: I can do this now (pause); the new ad is built paused for you to switch on

other_findings.what: Fix tagging for "Messenger Checkup new patients" before judging it.
other_findings.evidence: Meta counts 74 conversations, the export has 50 chats with this ad (68% match). Its $118 cost per sale (Scale) uses only the matched chats, so treat it as a rough read. A common cause is a chat the inbox files under an older thread, which drops the ad.
other_findings.who: your team does this (inbox tool settings)

reply_speed.caveat: Different chats answered at different speeds: a link, not proof.
